source_comparison: Exact binary comparison: current script equals archived original after exactly one old-path-to-new-path replacement. No other consumer script edits.
guard: Exact original SHA assertion remains unchanged before loading the parser.

context.source_lookup: Local parser-file location; content identity is the invariant SHA, not checkout name.
context.scientific_state: Retrospective standard-library recount of already exposed historical data; no new model result or authorization.
context.records: Existing behavior_recount.json and behavior_claims.json are byte-identical to originals in verified remote archive. No historical receipt is rewritten or re-signed.
context.future_identity: New recounts will capture changed script hash and parser path in PINS. Old source/path provenance remains historical.
context.adjacent_source: Neighboring annotation recount already uses CED parser at the same required SHA.
context.remaining_dependencies: External historical record files under rineya-dataset-retention-records and pure historical scorer modules are retained. CED parser checkout remains owned/retained.
context.frozen_protocols: Inspected pruning/pilot source-freeze and prereg files contain no required old recount-script hash/location binding; frozen pilot parameters/results stay unchanged.

publication_recommendation.parent_reason: Matches the active pruning owner checkout's existing pinned ancestry; do not move its branch or index, do not reparent onto another study.
publication_recommendation.preferred_reviewable_history: Use a separate temporary index outside active checkouts. First an archival baseline commit adds only exact original recount script; second a migration commit makes the one-line location change and adds migration evidence. Existing untracked research is left alone.
publication_recommendation.supporting_note: A concise cleanup publication index should link the original private release/archive and state external-data requirements. Full historical receipt bodies already live in verified release; their unchanged hashes are in this review.
avoid_staging: Historical datasets, checkpoints, native grants and model weights
Disposable caches and raw chat/owner DB snapshots
publication_recommendation.one_commit_alternative: If root prefers one evidence commit, add the current script plus migration plan/receipt/review with explicit original-release link. It will appear as a new tracked file rather than a one-line diff because the original was never committed.
